model.description: Model name used for batch completion, e.g. gpt-4o-batch, gemini-pro-1.5-001

messages.description:
List of messages
E.g.
```py
messages = [
    [{"role": "user", "content": "What's the time in UTC format? "}, {"role": "developer", "content": "You are a helpful assistant that answers programming questions"}],
    [{"role", "user", "content": "When was Open AI founded?"}]
]
```

optionsBatch.description: List of options that will be used to create inputs which match the order of messages
